definitions.gloss: property viewing; apartment showing; house tour
definitions.explanation: The act of visiting and inspecting a property (apartment, house) before deciding to rent or purchase it.

examples.japanese: {内見|ないけん}の{予約|よやく}をした。
examples.english: I made an appointment for a property viewing.

examples.japanese: {内見|ないけん}してから{決|き}めたい。
examples.english: I want to see the place before deciding.

examples.japanese: {不動産屋|ふどうさんや}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{物件|ぶっけん}の{内見|ないけん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to view the property with the real estate agent.

notes:
{内見|ないけん} is an important step in finding housing in Japan.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {内見|ないけん}に{行|い}く (to go for a property viewing)
- {内見|ないけん}をする (to do a property viewing)
- {内見|ないけん}の{予約|よやく} (property viewing appointment)

WHAT TO CHECK:
- {日当|ひあ}たり (sunlight)
- {収納|しゅうのう} (storage space)
- {設備|せつび} (facilities)
- {周辺環境|しゅうへんかんきょう} (surrounding area)

RELATED WORDS:
- {物件|ぶっけん}: property
- {不動産|ふどうさん}: real estate
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}: brokerage
